A simple yet stylish way to keep your desk organized. I designed and 3D printed this pencil holder in a vibrant pink color—perfect for adding a pop of color to your workspace! 🎨🖊

Want to print one for yourself? Download the model here: 

https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/home/pink-pencil-holder

Let me know what you think in the comments! Would you print it in pink or another color? 💡👇
